title: Refetch on every render
symptom: Network tab shows the bookings request firing continuously in next start.
hints: What is in the dependency array?
Is it a new object each render?
code:
const filters = { date, status };
useEffect(() => { load(filters) }, [filters]);
cause: filters is a new object each render, so the effect re-runs every time and sets state, which re-renders.
fix: Depend on primitives [date, status], or use useQuery with queryKey ['bookings', date, status].
verify: Request count stays at 1 per change in next build && next start.

title: Wrong booking updates on cancel
symptom: Cancelling the first row marks the second as cancelled.
cause: Index keys: after a filtered list changes, components keep the wrong state.
verify: Component test cancels booking id 2 and asserts only that row changes.

title: Auth lost on refresh
symptom: After F5 the user appears logged out though the cookie exists.
code: const [user, setUser] = useState(null); // set only after login
cause: User exists only in memory; nothing calls /me on startup.
fix: Bootstrap with useQuery(['me']) calling GET /me with credentials:'include' and populate the store; show a loading state meanwhile.
verify: Reload dashboard stays logged in; logged out redirects to /login.

title: Form doesn't validate
symptom: Empty name submits and the API returns 400 but the UI shows nothing.
cause: No zodResolver and no error rendering.
fix: useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(bookingSchema) }); render errors.name?.message with role='alert'; map server field errors too.
verify: RTL test: submit empty form, assert the alert message.

title: Hydration mismatch from date
symptom: Console: text content does not match server-rendered HTML on the bookings list.
hints: Which zone does the server use?
cause: Server and browser format in different zones/locales.
verify: No hydration warning; test under timezoneId America/New_York still shows the same string.
